attrs.reason: Management attributes net income increase to higher gross profit from higher sales and improved margins. Reported numbers confirm: revenue grew 35.7%, gross profit rose from $225.5M to $320.3M (margin 15.4%→16.1%), and operating profit increased (SG&A and depreciation grew slower). The divergence in operating cash flow is mechanically explained by working capital changes visible in the facts (receivables +$110M, inventory +$148M, current liabilities +$143M), but that does not contradict the net income explanation.
